ValidationRule.description: Only users with System Administrator profile can create new Accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, ISNEW(), OR(AND($Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "System Dataloader", $Profile.Name <> "Service Client Service Manager GM", $Profile.Name <> "Service Management STE"), $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Desktop__c <> TRUE) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create a new Account
